name: Scarecrow
description: The animated scarecrow is a tall, straw-stuffed figure held together by rough stitching and tattered clothes. It wields a rusty scythe, moving with stiff, jerky motions as it swings with unexpected strength. Hollow eyes glare from its sackcloth head, making it an intimidating presence on the field.

actions.name: Reap
actions.description: The scarecrow attacks a creature with it's scythe, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Tormenting Touch
actions.description: The scarecrow touches a creature and torments them, dealing psychic damage at the start of each of the target's turns while the scarecrow maintains their focus. The 3rd time this action deals damage, the effect ends but the target must make a resilience check or fall unconscious.

actions.name: Harvest
actions.description: The scarecrow empowers their next Reap action, allowing it to target an additional creature and extend the range by 1 unit. Additionally, a true hit forces the creatures to make a resilience check against the the total damage dealt after mitigation or become Afraid until the scarecrow reaches 0 health.

traits.name: Flammable
traits.description: When the scarecrow takes fire damage, it becomes ignited.
